label: Image
description: A photo, a screenshot or a diagram.

width.description: Width in pixels. The server fills it in from the file if you leave it out.

height.description: Height in pixels. The server fills it in from the file if you leave it out.

latitude.description: Latitude of what the image shows.

longitude.description: Longitude of what the image shows.

altitude.description: The altitude of what the image shows, in meters.

thumbnail.description: A small preview of the image, supplied by whoever saved it.
